name: Measles & vaccine-preventable
value: US cases at 35-year high; child deaths
summary: Child measles deaths in New York and Wisconsin; US cases remain at a 35-year high
state: New York reported its first measles death in more than 30 years on 3 Nov, with US cases at a 35-year high (Powers Health), and a child in Wisconsin died in the state's first measles death since 1990 (STAT, 5 Nov). This is a large outbreak in a high-income country; a multi-country surge with rising deaths has not been confirmed.
for_you: Check you and your children are up to date with MMR vaccination; follow NHS and UKHSA advice.
rubric_hit: Large outbreak in a high-income country = Watch

sources.title: Powers Health — New York reports first measles death in over 30 years

why: Falling vaccination rates are bringing back diseases once eliminated; measles is the canary for the rest.

rubric.alert: Multi-country surge with rising deaths, or polio/diphtheria resurgence in high-income countries.
rubric.watch: Large outbreaks in high-income countries, or loss of elimination status.
rubric.normal: No large outbreaks in high-income countries.
